proof_summary: Take the composite squarefree number \(n=23492890653051=3\cdot37\cdot43\cdot42307\cdot116341\). Using \(\sum_{k=1}^n\gcd(k,n)=\prod_{p\mid n}(2p-1)\), one gets \(610815156979325=26n-1\), so \(n\mid 1+\sum_{k=1}^n\gcd(k,n)\) and hence the quotient is \(1\) despite \(n\) being composite.
